prompt: After a year, Priya's guitar playing has plateaued. She can strum most chords but consistently stumbles on one fast chord change that appears in many songs. What is the best next practice plan?

options.text: Play whole songs at full speed until the change fixes itself
Stop playing songs for a month and only read music theory
Isolate that one change, practise it slowly with a metronome, raise the speed gradually, then put it back into songs
Buy new strings, because equipment usually causes plateaus

explanation: A plateau often hides one bottleneck sub-skill. Isolating it, slowing it down so errors are visible, and rebuilding speed is deliberate practice aimed at the actual limit.
